supersession_reason: The v1 scientific windows began at the evaluation checkpoint and therefore could not establish pre-cut support evolution. V2 preserves v1 pair selection while adding real prehistory and finite-difference evidence.
scientific_question: Whether capability stability requires a phase state, acceleration/history, or a piecewise transition law rather than a static first-order support state.

window_policy.parent_selection: Reuse the frozen v1 decline, matched-stable and recovery scientific windows without outcome-dependent reselection.
window_policy.restore_checkpoint_policy: Restore the immediately preceding legal 100-step checkpoint and reexecute to the capture start. The uncaptured warm-up is committed in the receipt but is not represented as observed support state.
window_policy.matching_and_labels: V1 pairing and recovery labels are inherited unchanged and are not recomputed from formal-v2 results.

finite_difference_contract.categorical_rule: Predictions are compared by identity-aligned equality/change masks; categorical values are never numerically subtracted.
finite_difference_contract.undefined_rule: A missing legal predecessor or successor produces an ExplicitDisposition, never an invented zero difference.

candidate_model_tiers.M3: phase state plus a discovered discrete local mode q_k
candidate_model_tiers.M4: other minimal state discovered from the complete stepwise GFG
candidate_model_tiers.hybrid_mode_rule: Mode count, meaning and switch conditions are discoverable candidates and are not predeclared as truth.

future_leakage_gate.enforcement: Every derived object carries temporal_role=input_available_at_cut or target_only_after_cut; the validator rejects a target-only origin entering a predictor input.

state_sufficiency_adjudication.acceptance_rule: Evolution direction is admitted only if it improves cross-run pre-decline prediction, resolves counterexamples net of complexity and passes derivative ablation.
state_sufficiency_adjudication.fail_closed_rule: If V and A do not distinguish future outcomes, report missing state; do not claim a derivative theory.

runtime_boundary.training_batch_policy: Load the content-addressed batch for each exact optimizer opportunity.
runtime_boundary.historical_rng_boundary: Historical RNG payloads were not materialized; deterministic current-runtime reexecution is reported honestly and never relabeled as historical restoration.
runtime_boundary.historical_exactness: Endpoint identity is claimed only on exact parameter and Adam hash equality; no tolerance repair.

vm_policy: The persistent VM and original persistent AI session remain running and unchanged; the AI is not resumed before all formal-v2 evidence and GFG validation pass.
